guide.openGame: Launch Wuthering Waves and open your Convene History so the page loads.

auto.step2: Open Windows PowerShell and run the command below. It only reads your game logs to find the link.
auto.step3: When it finds the link it copies it to your clipboard.

auto.step2: Open a terminal and run the command below. It only reads your game logs to find the link.
auto.step3: When it finds the link it copies it to your clipboard with pbcopy.

linux.step2: Open a terminal and run the command below. It only reads your game logs to find the link.
linux.step3: When it finds the link it copies it to your clipboard (needs xclip, xsel or wl-copy).

android.airplane: Follow the video tutorial by yukio36. It walks you through getting your link.
android.ascent1: Download Ascent v2.1.6. This method needs Android 11 or newer.
android.ascent2: Follow the guide by Mirai0009 to get your convene link with Ascent.

import.finalStep: Paste it below and tap Update records.
import.savedHint: Using the link saved from your last update. If it has expired, you'll be asked for a new one.
import.fromFileHint: Supports Solaris Record backups and WuWa Tracker exports (wuwatracker-pulls.json). New records are added; existing ones are never overwritten.
import.trackerNote: Client.log files and iOS exports can't be read here. Upload them on WuWa Tracker, choose Export Pull History, then import that JSON file.

solaris.step1: On the device that has your data, open Settings > Data & storage and tap Export backup.
solaris.step2: Move the saved .json file to this device if it is another one.

tracker.step1: Open WuWa Tracker's Data Settings and sign in or open the profile that has your pulls.
tracker.step2: Choose Export Pull History and save the JSON file (wuwatracker-pulls.json).

fileGuide.last: Tap Import from JSON file above and pick the file.

about.title: About
about.description: Track your Wuthering Waves convene history across multiple accounts: pity, pools and statistics.
about.reportBody: Open a GitHub issue. Attach the logs from Data & storage; UIDs and links are masked.
about.repoBody: Browse the code, releases and changelog on GitHub.
about.sourceBody: Records are fetched from the game's convene record service using the URL you paste. Item icons come from Kuro's guide server and encore.moe.

about.licensesBody: Solaris Record is open source under the MIT license. See the licenses of the libraries and fonts it uses.
